card.name: Earlier-known or long-hypothesised things
card.fires_on: Words in clauses saying something was proposed, hypothesised or known long before, such as 'despite being hypothesised' or 'had been known for years'. It also fires on the linking words inside those clauses.

modes.label: Disputed earlier credit
modes.description: Words in phrases such as 'some say he only improved on an earlier design'.
modes.example: although some say<< he>> only improved on an earlier design.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about proposals, ideas and hints, like 'proposal' and 'hinted'.
card.plain: It notices sentences saying an idea was suggested or known long before it was acted on.
